battle.name: 巴黎公社革命
battle.theater: 巴黎市區與凡爾賽前線
battle.brief: 一八七一年三月十八日，凡爾賽政府下令從蒙馬特爾奪回國民自衛軍大炮，步兵團拒絕開火，兩名將軍被殺，巴黎落入國民自衛軍手中。三月二十八日公社宣告成立，五月二十一日凡爾賽軍破城，二十八日城東陣地陷落。加特林機槍這類人力轉速射武器留在街壘，是凡爾賽縱隊逼近香榭麗舍時唯一能傾瀉彈幕的火力。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是法蘭西第三共和國的凡爾賽政府與其軍隊，以及自一八七一年三月二十八日至五月二十八日掌控首都的巴黎公社。國民自衛軍在圍城期間就是把巴黎武裝起來的樞紐：它按行政區組織，每區設營，營下分連，隊員來自工匠、雇工、小商販與雇員，並選出自己的區長與中隊長，因此在政府眼中既是一支武裝力量，也是一個政治組織。凡爾賽方面，梯也爾在一八七一年四月十七日由凡爾賽國民議會取得行政權，軍事指揮分三路：右岸由麥克馬洪元帥統率的凡爾賽軍主攻，西部封鎖由凡爾賽至巴黎的鐵路沿線與西部要塞，北部包圍線交由德·加利費侯爵。兵種編制沿用帝國時期的成法：步兵營採連制，另有常備線列步兵團、獵兵、胸甲騎兵（近衛騎兵與第八胸甲騎兵團）、工兵連，以及獨立的皇家砲兵隊。公社方面，國民自衛軍中央委員會在三月十八日之後成為巴黎唯一有效的政府，三月二十六日的選舉選出九十二名公社委員，其中工人比例相當高；軍隊則由各區聯防隊、公社直接指揮的守備營、由拉奧爾·里戈率領的「塞納縱隊」這類游擊部隊，以及由「十人委員會」集中收編的砲兵與速射武器組成。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Versailles government of the French Third Republic with its army, and the Paris Commune, which held the capital from 28 March to 28 May 1871. The National Guard was the hinge that had armed Paris during the siege: it was organised by arrondissement, each with a battalion, subdivided into companies, its members drawn from artisans, day-labourers, small traders and salaried clerks, and it elected its own district leaders and company captains, so that in the eyes of the government it was at once an armed force and a political organisation. On the Versailles side, Thiers obtained executive power from the National Assembly at Versailles on 17 April 1871, and military command was split three ways: the right bank was held by the Versailles army of Marshal MacMahon, which mounted the main attack; the western blockade covered the railway line from Versailles to Paris together with the western forts; the northern line of investment went to the Marquis de Failly. The arms organisation followed the practice of the Empire: infantry battalions on the company system, with regular line regiments, chasseurs, cuirassiers (the Guards and the 8th Cuirassiers), engineer companies, and an independent Royal Artillery. On the Commune side, the National Guard central committee became the only effective government in Paris after 18 March, and the election of 26 March returned ninety-two members of the Commune, a high proportion of them working men; the military force was made up of the federate companies of each district, the garrison battalions commanded directly by the Commune, the river column of Raoul Rigault as a kind of guerrilla body, and the artillery and rapid-fire weapons gathered together by the commission of tens.
people: 兩邊都有幾個決定結局的人。凡爾賽方面，梯也爾是行政總裁，態度強硬，拒絕任何交換，也拒絕承認公社；他身邊的秘書聖-伊萊爾那句「活該他們倒黴」成了公社最常被引用的反面形象。巴黎軍事總督特魯肖在四月中旬被撤換，主持軍務的麥克馬洪元帥推行五月二十一日的西線總攻，並在五月二十八日以公告宣布「巴黎得救」；北部包圍線則由德·加利費侯爵指揮。公社方面，被選為主席的布朗基在三月十七日即被捕，整個三月未能到場，三月三十日病逝，等於失去唯一有號召力的領袖；實際運作落在德萊克呂茲、歐仁·瓦爾蘭、古斯塔夫·萊弗朗斯與夏爾·朗熱等人身上，瓦爾蘭在四月三日的一次出擊中陣亡，德萊克呂茲在五月二十四日旺多姆廣場的進攻中中彈身亡。波蘭出身的軍人東布羅夫斯基是公社最傑出的將領，主持了四月初的西部反擊；把散落武器集中起來的「十人委員會」工作則由萊弗朗斯推動。拉奧爾·里戈主持軍法會，於五月二十四日被處決；費雷在同一天簽發了處決人質的命令，他本人也在月底被凡爾賽軍處決。二十四日當晚從蒙馬特爾發出進攻訊號的通訊旗信號員布魯瓦，成為這一役最具象徵性的角色。
peopleEn: Figures on both sides decided the outcome. On the Versailles side Thiers was the chief executive, adamant in refusing any exchange and in refusing to recognise the Commune; his secretary Saint-Hilaire's remark that it was so much the worse for them became the most quoted counter-image of the Commune. Trochu, military governor of Paris, was removed in mid-April, and Marshal MacMahon, who took charge of operations, drove the western offensive of 21 May and declared by proclamation on 28 May that Paris was saved; the northern line was commanded by the Marquis de Failly. On the Commune side, Blanqui, elected chairman, had been arrested on 17 March, never took his seat for the whole of March and died on 30 March, which amounted to losing the only leader with real authority; the actual work fell to Delescluze, Eugène Varlin, Gustave Lefrançais and Charles Longuet, with Varlin killed on 3 April during an attack and Delescluze mortally wounded on 24 May in the rush on the Place Vendôme. Dąbrowski, a Polish officer, was the Commune's best general and directed the western counter-offensive of early April, while the commission of tens, which gathered up the scattered weapons, was pushed by Lefrançais. Raoul Rigault presided over the military commission and was executed on 24 May; Ferré signed the order for the hostages on the same day, and was himself executed by the Versailles troops at the end of the month. Bourgeois, the semaphore signalman at Montmartre who sent the signal to attack on the night of the 24th, became the most symbolic figure of the whole affair.
kits: 任務單上的加特林機槍，是這場衝突裡最吃裝備細節的一件武器。它由六根槍管組成，射手不靠後坐自動裝填，而是靠手柄轉動，讓六管依次後退、裝填、擊發，後坐力分散在六次上，因此能壓住一個師的密集隊形；口徑約十毫米有奇，每分鐘可發射數百發，射程約八百至一千二百米，槍身重約四十五公斤。它由美國人理查德·加特林在一八六〇年前後定型，一八六一年開始量產，在美國內戰中大量使用，普法戰爭中法國與巴黎國民自衛軍都曾購買並使用。公社成立後繼承了圍城時期留下的一批，但數量有限，具體數目在當時的記錄裡沒有可靠統計，只能確定其存在而不能確定其規模。實戰中它的位置很清楚：它不是單兵武器，需要四到六人的操作組，分射手、轉柄手、裝填手與供彈手，必須架在固定陣位上，轉向遲緩，在狹窄街巷裡難以機動，機械結構在高射速下容易卡滯，缺備件的話常常在最需要火力時停擺。公社把這類速射武器配在關鍵街壘後方，用來封鎖通往市政廳與東部工人區的大道。同期的其他裝備包括法國一八六六年的夏塞波後膛步槍、帝國時期的十二發勒福什轉輪手槍、國民自衛軍警衛常用的加迪安左輪、一八七〇年法軍的百三十七毫米蒙蒂尼機關槍，以及從蒙馬特爾等「砲兵公園」用馬車與手推車運到各區的數百門舊式野戰砲。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun named on the task sheet is the piece of equipment that tells you most about how this conflict was fought. It consists of six barrels; the firer does not rely on recoil to load, but turns a crank so that the six barrels in turn recoil, load and fire, the recoil being spread over six separate shots, which is why it could pin down a division drawn up in close order. The bore is a little over ten millimetres, it can fire several hundred rounds a minute, its effective range is roughly eight hundred to twelve hundred metres, and the gun weighs about forty-five kilograms. It was developed by the American Richard Gatling around 1860 and produced from 1861, was used in quantity in the American Civil War, and was bought and used by France and by the Paris National Guard during the Franco-Prussian War. The Commune inherited a batch of them from the siege, but the number was small, and there is no reliable figure for it in the contemporary records: their presence can be established, their scale cannot. Their place in the fighting is nevertheless clear. It was not a single-man weapon; it needed a crew of four to six, divided between firer, crankmen, loaders and feed men; it had to be set up on a fixed emplacement; it traversed slowly and could hardly be manoeuvred in narrow streets; its mechanism was prone to jamming at high rates of fire, and without spare parts it often stopped at the very moment when its fire was needed. The Commune distributed such rapid-fire weapons behind the more important barricades, to sweep the avenues that led to the Hôtel de Ville and to the working-class districts in the east. The other equipment in service at the same time included the French Chassepot service rifle of 1866, the twelve-shot Lefaucheux revolver of the Empire, the Gardien revolver carried by National Guard sentries, the 137mm Montigny machine gun of the French army of 1870, and several hundred old field guns hauled from the artillery parks at Montmartre and elsewhere into the several districts on carts and hand-barrows.
tactics: 公社的戰術起點，是一八七〇年留下的城市防禦體系：蒂埃爾城牆、西部要塞帶與穿越市區的鐵路。三月十八日至二十二日，各區把城內公有火炮轉移到街壘，拆毀屋牆作射擊孔，用馬車與手推車把蒙馬特爾高地的大炮運進城；國民自衛軍依托城牆與要塞形成環形防禦，打算讓凡爾賽軍撞在城牆上。四月上旬的幾次交手證明這種打算站不住：四月三日凡爾賽遠征失敗，四月六日布茲昂瓦一役公社一度奪回凡爾賽門，但凡爾賽軍很快以優勢兵力重奪，並在五月二十一日從西部城門與鐵路缺口的薄弱處突破。凡爾賽軍的戰術很清楚：集中砲火、穿牆逼近、逐街清除，逐日由西向東推進，集中指揮與兵力遠勝各區各自為戰的公社；反過來，奧斯曼改造後的寬闊大道讓公社的街壘難以銜接，巷戰在東部工人區一度極為激烈。加特林機槍在這種環境裡的用法是固定的：架在街壘後方，瞄準大道與廣場，連續壓制密集隊形，一旦被側翼迂迴或砲火封住射界就只能棄守。二十四日旺多姆廣場一役，公社縱隊在近衛胸甲騎兵的衝鋒與密集步兵面前崩潰，損失慘重；此後公社退守梅尼蒙當、美麗城與拉魯埃，最後在拉雪茲公墓一帶抵抗到五月二十八日。
tacticsEn: The starting point of the Commune's tactical thinking was the urban defence system left over from 1870: the enceinte de Thiers, the belt of western forts and the railway lines cutting across the city. Between 18 and 22 March the districts shifted the city's guns into the barricades, broke through the walls of houses to make firing loopholes, and hauled the heavy guns down from the Montmartre heights on carts and hand-barrows; the National Guard, relying on the enceinte and the forts, built a ring of defence and counted on the Versailles army running into the walls. The exchanges of early April showed that this calculation would not hold: the Versailles expedition of 3 April failed, and on 6 April the Commune retook the Porte de Versailles at Buzenval, but the Versailles troops came back with superior numbers and retook it, and on 21 May they broke through the weak points of the western gates and of the railway cutting. The method of the Versailles army was plain: mass the artillery, drive breaches through the walls, clear street by street, and advance from west to east day by day, with a concentration of command and numbers that the district-by-district defence of the Commune could not match; conversely, the broad avenues cut by Haussmann meant the Commune barricades could not be linked together, and the street fighting in the eastern working-class quarters was at times extremely heavy. The Gatling gun had a fixed use in such conditions: emplaced behind a barricade, aimed down an avenue or across a square, sustaining fire on troops drawn up in close order, and liable to be abandoned as soon as its arc of fire was covered from the flank or masked by artillery. On 24 May the Commune columns broke before the charge of the Guard cuirassiers and the massed infantry of the Place Vendôme and suffered heavily; the Commune then fell back on Ménilmontant, Belleville and La Roquette and held out around the Père Lachaise until 28 May.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下：巴黎國民自衛軍在圍城期間註冊的人數約三十萬，但三月十八日之後真正能上陣的武裝力量，不同來源估計從一萬二千到兩萬不等，隨動員增到四月底約五萬，其中在各區街壘輪值的聯防員約一萬至一萬五；凡爾賽軍在四月初只有一萬七千至兩萬五千人，到五月二十一日總攻時集結約八萬五千至十五萬。巴黎市內公有與國民自衛軍籍的大炮共四百多門，公社在起義後數日內即完成轉移。流血周七日間，凡爾賽軍由西部城牆向東推進約六至八公里，逐日逐街奪取，二十四日旺多姆廣場一役公社縱隊即損失數千人。戰後數千名公社支持者被逮捕，經臨時軍事法庭審判後，數十人被判處決，更多人被判監禁，約四千人被流放至新喀里多尼亞；一八七一年六月十一日通過流放法，一八八〇年七月十一日則由國民議會頒布全面大赦。加特林機槍的諸項性能有同期資料可查——六管、口徑約十毫米、每分鐘數百發、射程八百至一千二百米、槍重約四十五公斤、需四人以上操作——但巴黎市內實際可用數量沒有可靠統計，只能確定它是零星配發，而不是成建制配備。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The National Guard of Paris had a registered strength of about three hundred thousand during the siege, but after 18 March the number that could actually be put in the line is estimated by different sources at between twelve and twenty thousand, rising with mobilisation to about fifty thousand by the end of April, of whom perhaps ten to fifteen thousand were the federates rotating on the barricades; the Versailles army numbered only seventeen to twenty-five thousand men in early April and had concentrated perhaps eighty-five to a hundred and fifty thousand by the general assault of 21 May. Paris held more than four hundred guns of municipal and National Guard ownership, and the Commune completed the transfer of them within days of the rising. Over the seven days of the Bloody Week the Versailles troops advanced some six to eight kilometres eastward from the western wall, taking street by street and day by day, and the Commune columns lost several thousand men in the single action of the Place Vendôme on the 24th. After the fighting, several thousand supporters of the Commune were arrested and tried before improvised military courts; dozens were sentenced to death, many more to prison, and about four thousand to deportation to New Caledonia; the law of deportation was passed on 11 June 1871, and a full amnesty was proclaimed by the National Assembly on 11 July 1880. Contemporary data exist for the performance of the Gatling gun — six barrels, a bore of roughly ten millimetres, several hundred rounds a minute, a range of eight hundred to twelve hundred metres, a weight of about forty-five kilograms, and a crew requirement of more than four men — but there is no reliable count of how many were actually available in Paris, and only their sporadic rather than systematic distribution can be established.
cause: 打起來的原因可以分成遠因與近因。遠因是普法戰爭的敗局：一八七〇年九月二日色當會戰後，拿破崙三世投降，第二帝國崩潰，巴黎被普軍圍困到一八七一年一月，全城生產停擺、物價飛漲，失業與飢餓在工人區尤其嚴重。近因是共和國內部的政治清算：一八七一年二月八日的國民大會選舉讓保皇派與共和派撕破臉，第三共和國成立不到兩個月，就在如何對付武裝起來的巴黎上僵持不下；政府拒絕延期戰時債務，拒絕讓被解職的國民自衛軍指揮官復職，國民自衛軍中央委員會也拒絕交出自購的四百多門大炮。三月十七日政府決定重新武裝巴黎並沒收這些大炮，三月十八日夜由正規軍與警察執行，兩個中隊拒絕向聚集的國民自衛軍與民眾開火，反而與他們站在一起；同日被指曾下令開槍的兩名將軍被當場殺死，成為雙方徹底決裂的導火線。梯也爾隨即撤出巴黎退到凡爾賽，衝突自此升級為內戰。
causeEn: The reasons for the fighting divide into distant causes and immediate ones. The distant cause was the ruin of the Franco-Prussian War: after the battle of Sedan on 2 September 1870 Napoleon III surrendered, the Second Empire collapsed, Paris was besieged by the Prussian army until January 1871, production in the city stopped, prices rose steeply, and unemployment and hunger were worst in the working-class quarters. The immediate cause was a political reckoning inside the Republic: the National Assembly election of 8 February 1871 split the monarchists from the republicans irreconcilably, and less than two months after the Third Republic was proclaimed the government and the capital were locked in a quarrel over how to deal with an armed Paris. The government refused to postpone the debts contracted during the siege, refused to restore the dismissed National Guard commanders, and the National Guard central committee refused to hand over the four hundred-odd guns it had bought with its own money. On 17 March the government decided to rearm Paris and to seize those guns, and the operation was carried out on the night of 18 March by regular troops and police; two companies refused to fire on the assembled National Guard and the crowds and instead stood with them, and the same day two generals who were said to have given the order to fire were killed on the spot, which became the flashpoint for a complete break between the two sides. Thiers then withdrew from Paris to Versailles, and the confrontation escalated into civil war.
impact: 公社雖只存在七十二天，卻成了左翼政治的第一個政權樣本。馬克思在《法蘭西內戰》中稱它為「工人的巴黎」，恩格斯在談公社時使用的「無產階級專政」一詞從此定型，共產主義運動、國際主義與後來俄國的革命宣傳都不斷引用它；公社期間誕生的《國際歌》更成為國際工人運動的聲音。軍事上的教訓同樣被反覆引用：未能控制凡爾賽、沒有奪取國家銀行、沒有徵召民兵並集中指揮、對外敵過於寬大，馬克思與後來的列寧都把這些列為致命弱點，恩格斯則強調公社沒有常備軍、實行區域自治的意義。對法國本身的影響更為長久：第三共和國的憲法修正、高等教育世俗化與教會衝突——一八八〇至一八八一年的費里法與一九〇五年的政教分離法——都帶著這段創傷，而一九八〇年七月的大赦、一九八一年後歷屆政府在「公社社員牆」前的紀念儀式，一直到二〇一六年國民議會通過為公社平反的決議，都是這段歷史在政治上的回聲。巴黎的市政制度，例如公共交通、由選舉產生的市府職位與工人合作社，也在公社之後被部分保留。
impactEn: Although it lasted only seventy-two days, the Commune became the first political model of the left. Marx called it the workers' Paris in his pamphlet on the Civil War in France, and the term dictatorship of the proletariat, which Engels used when discussing the Commune, was fixed by that example; the communist movement, the international labour movement and the revolutionary propaganda of later Russia borrowed from it without end, and the song of the Internationale, written during the Commune itself, became the voice of the international workers' movement. The military lessons were quoted just as often: failure to hold Versailles, failure to seize the national bank, failure to conscript the militia and to concentrate command, and excessive clemency towards the enemy were all listed by Marx and, later, by Lenin as fatal weaknesses, while Engels stressed the significance of the absence of a standing army and of local self-government. The effect on France itself was longer-lived: the constitutional revisions of the Third Republic, the secularisation of higher education and the conflict with the Church, including the Ferry laws of 1880-81 and the separation of Church and State in 1905, all carry the scar of those months; and the amnesty of July 1880, the commemorations held at the wall of the federates by governments from 1981 onwards, and the resolution of the National Assembly in 2016 calling for the rehabilitation of the Commune are all political echoes of this history. Municipal institutions in Paris, such as public transport, elected municipal offices and workers' cooperatives, were in part preserved after the Commune.
result: 結果是凡爾賽方的完全勝利，但代價慘重。五月二十一日凡爾賽軍突破西部城門，二十四日在旺多姆廣場以近衛胸甲騎兵與步兵擊潰公社的攻勢，德萊克呂茲陣亡；二十五日以後戰線退向巴黎東部工人區，二十七日至二十八日在梅尼蒙當、美麗城、拉魯埃與拉雪茲公墓一帶逐屋抵抗，麥克馬洪在二十八日下午以公告宣布秩序恢復。之後是大規模的逮捕、臨時軍事法庭的審判與執行槍決，包括拉雪茲公墓的「公社社員牆」；公社委員與支持者大批流亡比利時、英國、義大利與西班牙，一八八〇年大赦後陸續回國並組織「公社老戰士兄弟會」。巴黎的街壘被拆除，旺多姆圓柱一度被拉倒，一八七三年重新豎立。凡爾賽方面在巴黎保留軍事法庭與非常措施五年，一八七二年另行制定防制左翼社團的法律，到十九世紀末才逐步撤除。公社作為一次武裝奪權的樣本，此後在全球被反覆引用，也被反覆檢討。
resultEn: The result was a complete victory for Versailles, bought at a heavy price. On 21 May the Versailles army broke through the western gates; on the 24th they broke the Commune's attack in the Place Vendôme with the Guard cuirassiers and massed infantry, and Delescluze was killed; after the 25th the front fell back to the working-class districts in the east of Paris, and between the 27th and the 28th resistance was fought house by house around Ménilmontant, Belleville, La Roquette and the Père Lachaise, until MacMahon proclaimed by announcement on the afternoon of the 28th that order was restored. Then came mass arrests, trials before improvised military courts and executions by firing squad, including at the wall of the federates in the Père Lachaise; members of the Commune and thousands of supporters went into exile in Belgium, Britain, Italy and Spain, and after the amnesty of 1880 returned to form the brotherhood of the old Communards. The barricades were dismantled, the Vendôme Column was pulled down and put back up in 1873. On the Versailles side military courts and emergency measures were kept in force in Paris for five years, a further law against left-wing associations was passed in 1872, and these exceptional measures were only gradually withdrawn by the end of the century. The Commune, as the model of an armed seizure of power, was invoked and re-examined all over the world in the decades that followed.
